compiled_state.title: merge-to-main-pr.sh: PR2 created in two-tier flow -> polling phase aborts with 'could not resolve PR number', PR2 left unmerged
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

In the two-tier merge-to-main flow, after PR1 (source->staged) merges and the script opens PR2 (staged-*->main), it prints 'INFO: Created PR #NNN: <url>' immediately followed by 'ERROR: could not resolve PR number for polling phase' and stops — leaving PR2 OPEN and unmerged (must be merged manually).

## Reproduction
Observed on two consecutive runs this session: PR2 #529 (go-live) and PR2 #531 (coverage-invariant fix). Both: PR1 merged successfully, PR2 created, then the polling phase failed to resolve PR2's number despite the number being printed in the preceding INFO line.

## Expected
After creating PR2, the script resolves PR2's number, waits for its required checks, and merges it.

## Suspected area
plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh PR2/staged->main phase — the created PR number printed in the INFO line is not captured into the variable the polling phase reads (possibly interacting with the resume-hardening staged_branch persistence added this session).

**code_version:** c5eba10e83539d3e92bbb45abfaccb84fef22c99

comments.body: ROOT_CAUSE (high confidence, empirically reproduced): _phase_staged_intermediate re-points BRANCH to staged at merge-to-main-pr.sh:994 but calls undefined _state_write_branch (no-op) instead of _state_init, so the staged-keyed state file is never created on the fresh path; _state_write_pr_meta no-ops on its [[ -f ]] guard, PR2 number never persisted, polling read empty -> error line 3009. --resume works (re-invokes _state_init at line 2885). Fix: replace dead _state_write_branch call with _state_init + re-set staged_branch; add gh pr list fallback in polling block (defense-in-depth + self-heals open PR2s). testing_mode=RED.
